name: Quant v0
description: Experimental quant-research harness testing whether point-in-time fusion research produces genuine out-of-sample alpha: independent, IC-weighted alpha signals, a pluggable (non-mean-variance) portfolio-construction layer, a shrink-only risk stage, a bounded transaction-cost model, and a null-research ablation switch — evaluated via walk-forward validation against frozen fusion-fundamental-v6/fusion-fundamental-v7 benchmarks.
